zh.title: 富田電機：歐洲無人機客戶包下銅鑼高效馬達新產能
zh.summary: 富田電機銅鑼廠新增高效驅動馬達產線；年產能預計由10萬顆提升至40萬顆
body: 馬達製造與系統整合商富田電機董事長張金鋒表示，公司已在苗栗銅鑼廠新增1條高效驅動馬達產線，年產能預計從10萬顆提高到40萬顆，相關產能已被歐洲無人機客戶包下，主要應用於商用與農用低空載具。
張金鋒指出，富田電機低空載具馬達與動力系統產品的客戶以美國與歐洲廠商為主。針對美國對進口無人機及零組件課徵關稅，他認為對富田電機相對有利，台灣廠商可受惠轉單與非紅供應鏈效應。
富田電機先前成立小型化業務部門，鎖定高精度、輕量化馬達產品開發，切入無人機、低軌衛星、機器狗等應用。張金鋒表示，目前小型化部門業績占比約3%至5%，預估2027年可超過1成。

en.title: Futian Motor: European Drone Customer Books New Tonglu High-Efficiency Motor Capacity
en.summary: Futian Motor adds high-efficiency drive motor line at Tonglu; annual capacity expected to rise from 100,000 to 400,000 units
body: Futian Motor chairman Zhang Jin-feng said the company has added one high-efficiency drive motor production line at its Tonglu plant in Miaoli, with annual capacity expected to increase from 100,000 to 400,000 units. The capacity has been booked by a European drone customer for commercial and agricultural low-altitude vehicle applications.

Zhang noted that Futian Motor's low-altitude vehicle motor and power system customers are primarily U.S. and European manufacturers. Regarding U.S. tariffs on imported drones and components, he said the impact is relatively favorable for Futian Motor, as Taiwanese manufacturers can benefit from order redirection and non-red supply chain effects.

Futian Motor previously established a miniaturization business unit focused on high-precision, lightweight motor products for drones, low-orbit satellites, robot dogs and other applications. Zhang said the unit currently accounts for about 3% to 5% of revenue, projected to exceed 10% by 2027.
